Review complete. Verdict: **approve** (tier1).

Key findings:
- Diff is additive/isolated — docs + two Python scripts, no `.github/workflows/**`, no migrations/schema/auth/payment/security path matches, correctly tier1.
- Verified live rather than trusting the self-report: all 25 claimed `compliance-tracker/src/lib/engines/*.ts` files exist on disk (zero stale drops), both generation modes ran end-to-end successfully, and a hand-crafted test CSV confirmed the ingest script correctly accepts valid rows and rejects an invalid End User Role plus a hardcoded-name literal.
- The sandbox write guard (path-traversal/symlink protection) is unchanged and still sound; capability-derived output filenames are constrained to validated values, so no injection surface was introduced.
- One cosmetic nit: `DEFAULT_INDUSTRIES` is dead code (defined, never used) — noted but non-blocking.
- Cleaned up test artifacts I generated during verification (extra request files, one test CSV row) and regenerated coverage/duplicates reports to restore prior sandbox state; no repo files were touched (`git status` clean).

`review-verdict.json` written to the workspace root as specified.
